name: The Sadie Family Palladius

summary.es: The Sadie Family Palladius es un vino blanco de The Sadie Family Wines, con la denominación Wine of Origin Swartland, en Sudáfrica.
summary.en: The Sadie Family Palladius is a white wine from The Sadie Family Wines, made under the Wine of Origin Swartland appellation in South Africa.
summary.fr: The Sadie Family Palladius est un vin blanc de The Sadie Family Wines, élaboré sous l’appellation Wine of Origin Swartland (Afrique du Sud).
summary.it: The Sadie Family Palladius è un vino bianco di The Sadie Family Wines, prodotto nella denominazione Wine of Origin Swartland (Sudafrica).

body.es:
Tiene crianza en madera. Su graduación es de 13,5 % vol.

Bodega del enólogo Eben Sadie en el Paardeberg, en el Swartland, figura clave de la renovación del vino sudafricano con sus mezclas Columella y Palladius y su serie de viñas viejas.
body.en:
It is aged in wood. It has 13.5% ABV.

Winery of winemaker Eben Sadie on the Paardeberg, in the Swartland, a key figure in the renewal of South African wine with his Columella and Palladius blends and his old-vine series.
body.fr:
Il est élevé en bois. Il titre 13,5 % vol.

Domaine du vinificateur Eben Sadie sur le Paardeberg, dans le Swartland, figure clé du renouveau du vin sud-africain avec ses assemblages Columella et Palladius et sa série de vieilles vignes.
body.it:
È affinato in legno. Ha 13,5% vol.

Cantina dell’enologo Eben Sadie sul Paardeberg, nello Swartland, figura chiave del rinnovamento del vino sudafricano con gli uvaggi Columella e Palladius e la serie di vecchie vigne.

pairing.en: Fish, shellfish, rice dishes, fresh cheeses
pairing.fr: Poissons, fruits de mer, plats de riz, fromages frais
pairing.it: Pesce, frutti di mare, risotti, formaggi freschi
